# Hosea Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 330v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:1** Say [imru] to-your-brothers [acheikhem] Ammi [My-People] and-to-your-sisters Ruchamah [Pitied].

**2:2** "Contend [rivu] with-your-mother [be-immekhem], contend [rivu]; for she [is] not my-wife [ishti] and-I [am] not her-husband [ishah]; and-let-her-remove [vetaser] her-harlotry [zuneyha] from-her-face [mi-paneyha] and-her-adultery [vena'afufeyha] from-between her-breasts [shadeyha]."

**2:14** "Therefore [lakhen], behold, I [am] alluring-her [mefateyha], and-I-will-lead-her [veholakhtiyah] to-the-wilderness [ha-midbar], and-I-will-speak [vedibbarti] to her-heart [al-libbah]."

**2:15** "And-I-will-give [venatati] to-her her-vineyards [krameyha] from-there, and-the-Valley of-Akhor [Achor] as-a-door [le-petach] of-hope [tiqvah]; and-she-will-sing [ve'antah] there as-in-the-days of-her-youth [ne'ureyha], and-as-the-day of-her-going-up [alotah] from-the-land of-Mitsrayim."

**2:16** "And-it-will-be in-that day," declares YHWH, "you-will-call-me [tiqre'i] 'My-Husband' [Ishi] and-you-will-no-longer [lo tiqre'i li od] call-me 'My-Ba'al' [Baali]."

**2:19** "And-I-will-betroth-you [ve'erastikh] to-me forever [le-olam]; I-will-betroth-you to-me in-righteousness [be-tsedeq] and-in-justice [u-vemishpat] and-in-loyalty [u-ve-chesed] and-in-compassion [u-ve-rachamim]."

**2:20** "And-I-will-betroth-you to-me in-faithfulness [be-emunah]; and-you-will-know [veyada'at] YHWH."

**2:23** "And-I-will-sow-her [u-zeraatiyha] for-me in-the-land [ba-arets], and-I-will-have-pity [verichamti] on-Lo-Ruchamah; and-I-will-say to-Lo-Ammi, 'You [are] my-people [ammi atta]'; and-he will-say, 'My-God [elohai].'"

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.14-15 — "alluring her to the wilderness":** The most tender passage in Hosea. YHWH will court Israel again — leading her to the wilderness (as in the Exodus) for a new beginning. The Valley of Achor ("trouble," cf. Joshua 7) becomes a "door of hope."

**v.16 — "Ishi" vs. "Baali":** Both words can mean "my husband," but *Ba'al* also means "master/lord" and is the name of the Canaanite deity. The new covenant will be marked by intimacy (*Ishi*), not domination (*Baali*).

**v.19-20 — The betrothal:** Three betrothal declarations — *le-olam* (forever), *be-tsedeq u-vemishpat* (in righteousness and justice), *be-emunah* (in faithfulness). The covenant language of marriage as the core metaphor for YHWH-Israel relationship.

*— EMET*
